- [USER] Asked for more information about the specialist support staff at the University of Nottingham and how to access their services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Disability Support Team provides support to students with disabilities, including physical, sensory, and mental health conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Disability Support Team offers advice on disability-related issues, adjustments to learning environments, and exam arrangements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Student Services Centre provides advice and support on accommodation, finances, and personal issues, with specialist support for specific groups like carers and estranged students.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Faith and Spirituality Centre offers support for students of all faiths and beliefs, including spiritual guidance and interfaith activities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To access services, students can visit the Student Services Centre in person or contact them via email or phone to book an appointment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Disability Support Team has a self-referral form available online for requesting support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Faith and Spirituality Centre is open to all students without requiring an appointment.
